composite_ranking_energy_E_total.formula: E_total(x, y, r) = E_def(x, y, r) + 0.15 * E_depth(x, y) / log2(2 + delta_tok), where rho_diff = delta_tok / max(1, L_cand).

cross_difference_block.input: Candidate token states H_cand cross-attending to reference token states H_ref with SequenceMatcher line-shift-invariant diff tags, producing span-normalized changed-token mean/max pooling (for E_def) alongside full-sequence mean/RMS difference pooling (for E_depth) and explicit normalized diff-fraction rho_diff = delta_tok / max(1, L_cand).

cumulative_corruption_depth_head_E_depth.features: z_ref, z_cand, z_cand - z_ref, |z_cand - z_ref|, full-sequence mean_diff and rms_diff, rho_diff, log2(2 + delta_tok), and syntactic defect-site counts.

shared_siamese_encoder_Phi_omega.input: PairFormTokenizerv3 (max_seq_len = 384) with SequenceMatcher line-shift-invariant syntactic alignment, diagnostic-and-diff prioritized windowing, and lexical separation of bound/imported new identifiers (<BOUND_NEW_ID>) from unbound free identifiers (<UNBOUND_NEW_ID>) and _-prefixed hygiene bindings (<UNDERSCORE_ID>) with zero rce check calls.

span_invariant_defect_head_E_def.features: z_cand, max_pool(H_cand), unit-normalized direction (z_cand - z_ref) / (||z_cand - z_ref||_2 + 1e-4), span-normalized changed-token mean/max cross-difference, rule_emb(r), explicit normalized diff-fraction rho_diff = delta_tok / max(1, L_cand), and zero-checker syntactic validity ratios.

disjoint_filter_rules: 1. Exact 4-layer exclusion from FormJEPA-v1 and FormEBM-v2: exclude all 65 unique file paths in the 151-task ladder and all 40 paths in the H15 residual set.
2. Exclude any Form sharing a filename stem or numeric-stripped program slug (87 forbidden slugs) or conformance provenance with any evaluation task.
3. Exclude any Form sharing a primary state, actor, or module declaration identifier (62 forbidden identifiers) with any evaluation task.

4. Exclude any Form whose rce fmt nameless SHA-256 (shape_hash), canonical rce fmt SHA-256, or raw UTF-8 SHA-256 matches any original, mutant, or HEAD file of the 151 ladder or 40 H15 tasks (458 forbidden digests).
data_and_leakage_controls.inference_zero_checker_leakage: FormEBM-v3 computes E_def, E_depth, and E_total purely from neural forward passes over (x, diag_of_x, y_cand) without invoking rce check on y_cand; rce check + obligation preservation is used strictly as the training-split label oracle and post-scoring evaluation oracle.
data_and_leakage_controls.multi_span_synthetic_training: Multi-span benign/valid Form rewrites (k = 2..10 simultaneous alpha-renames, constant updates, comment/use additions, and multi-site repairs verified rce check valid) paired against 0-edit NO_OP, 1-token defects, and multi-token invalid defects (rce check rejected) are generated strictly from the 1,106 train_forms (and validation monitor slice strictly from the 144 val_forms; zero H15, ladder, or test_forms leakage).
data_and_leakage_controls.split_rule: Exact deterministic FormJEPA-v1 / FormEBM-v2 split of the 1,387 disjoint valid Form shapes by int(shape_hash[:16], 16) % 10: 0..7 -> 1,106 train Forms, 8 -> 144 validation Forms, 9 -> 137 unseen held-out test Forms.

energy_and_telemetry.energy_separation_rule: est_j, reported_j, and measured_j are strictly separated and never summed.

falsifiers.F1_collapse: Post-training effective rank of z_ref or z_cand on validation pairs drops below 16 (of d=256) or mean coordinate std drops below 0.25.
falsifiers.F2_leakage: Any training or validation example shares a path, slug, primary declaration identifier, or shape_hash with the 137 test Forms, 151 ladder tasks, or 40 H15 residual tasks, or invokes rce check on candidate y_cand inside FormEBM-v3.
falsifiers.F3_h5_or_h11_regression: Held-out H5 AUROC drops below 0.85 or held-out H11 strict 5-step monotonicity drops below 80.0%.
falsifiers.F4_ood_inversion_unresolved: Pooled cross-task AUROC on the 40-task H15 residual candidate pool remains <= 0.50.

objectives.cross_span_defect_contrastive_loss: Within-pair margin max(0, m_val + E_def(x, y^+, r) - E_def(x, y^-, r)) + all-pairs cross-task batch margin max(0, m_cross + E_def(x_i, y_i^+, r_i) - E_def(x_j, y_j^-, r_j)) + cross-task E_total margin max(0, m_cross + E_total(x_i, y_i^+, r_i) - E_total(x_j, y_j^-, r_j)) + L2 positive anchor E_def(x, y^+, r)^2 across both single-span and k=2..10 multi-span valid rewrites vs 0/1/multi-token invalid defects.
objectives.pairwise_5step_corruption_depth_loss: mean_{0 <= i < j <= 5} max(0, gamma_depth * (j - i) + E_depth(y_0, y_i) - E_depth(y_0, y_j)) + mean_{0 <= i < j <= 5} max(0, gamma_tot * (j - i) + E_total(y_0, y_i, OK) - E_total(y_0, y_j, OK)) + 0.10 * E_depth(y_0, y_0)^2 + 0.10 * E_def(y_0, y_0, OK)^2.
